register.title: Evan Daniel's n236 certificate at 5ad0069, issue659
register.headline: A smaller packing of 236 squares from Evan Daniel's basin explorer, after Chaoweeraprasit's composition, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its 6-group regularized view at the same side. The source reports a KKT local minimum strict modulo 92 exact flat motions, 114 corner-corner contacts with no corner-corner MILP descent and 18 rattlers, and measures it against #481's packing as a different local minimum, with no tilt angle shared; those are numerical evidence at 80 digits, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose basin explorer descended to this packing from a rebuild of Nate Chaoweeraprasit's (itsnaka's) SQUISH Mondrian composition of #481 (T-136), and credit that composition for the construction, as the issue asks; the rebuild used Kingbird's s(152)_r2 corner piece and itsnaka's s(88) (#422). The search, the checks and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code) under Evan Daniel's direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then adopt at 236.
